description: A shell script that tests the performance of tag-following in git repositories with many disconnected tags and large pack files. It constructs a test scenario with a parent and child repository, creates a large number of commits, tags, and packs, and performs fetch operations to evaluate performance.

methods.name: create_history
methods.description: Creates a long, pseudo-random commit history on a specified branch with a specific number of commits, each referencing a specified blob. Uses Perl scripting and git fast-import.

methods.name: create_tags
methods.description: Creates a series of tags for each commit in a given revision range, using Perl scripting and git update-ref.
